notes: Registry of funds whose NAV, return, and flow series feed the fund-flow track.
SEC entries were resolved on 2026-10-21 from EDGAR full-text search (forms=NPORT-P) and each registrant's series list; see docs/SOURCES.md.

Form N-PORT Part B carries, for each of the preceding three months, net assets, total return per class, and the value of shares sold, reinvested, and redeemed. Part C carries holdings with CUSIPs. Only the quarter-end filing is public, 60 days after quarter end, but it reports all three months.
A series_id of null means the registrant files a single series; select by CIK and confirm seriesName in the XML.
Entries with role 'mention_only' matched the search terms because they hold or describe cat-bond funds; they are listed so a later pass does not rediscover them.
